{{Quote|TK-421, why aren't you at your post? TK-421, do you copy?|Pol Treidum|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Pol Treidum''' was a a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gantry officer/Legends|gantry officer]] who was in charge of maintaining the magnetic field, atmosphere, and security in [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. He held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Take over. We've got a bad transmitter. I'll see what I can do.|Pol Treidum to his partner|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:PolTreidum.png|thumb|left|180px|Treidum pages TK-421.]]
After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] successful mission on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], Treidum was constantly paranoid of Rebel spies infiltrating the Death Star.<ref name="ANH" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he was stationed in [[Docking Control Room 327]] when the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was drawn into [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]] by a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. While a scanning crew went on board, Treidum noticed that [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[TK-421/Legends|TK-421]] and [[TK-422]] were not at their posts outside the ''Millennium Falcon''. After trying unsuccessfully to hail TK-421 through the comm system, Treidum looked out the observation port to see a disguised [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] walk down the ''Falcon''{{'s}} loading ramp and bump a fist at his helmet. Taking this to mean there was a faulty transmitter, Treidum opened the door to go check on the problem, only to be knocked unconscious by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] fist, propelling him back into the room,<ref name="ANH" /> resulting in his death.<ref name="Death Star" /> [[Unidentified gantry officer|His partner]] was then shot by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="ANH" />

Treidum's body was later viewed through a security camera in the office by Death Star librarian [[Atour Riten]].<ref name="Death Star" />

==Personality and traits==
Pol Treidum sported the prominent sideburns that were popular among the Imperial officer class at the time.<ref name="The Jedi Academy Sourcebook">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
